opencode-ahp `0.1.11` — AHP 1.0.0 host for opencode v2, published to npm.

**Install** ([README — Install](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/blob/main/README.md#install)):

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-ahp
```

or pin this build: `opencode plugin add opencode-ahp@0.1.11`

## Commits
- [931b44f](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/931b44f976ab5ab6e4c4f8ccb40a0efa7a624249) Implement chat/truncated (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [6c6b98a](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/6c6b98adeb0657b00840ed7db21ab35e66cfeed6) Split host.test.ts into per-section suites (Matt Zinkevicius)
- [a3df6c4](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/a3df6c4246e9421b710f136b43ad67840aa3fa27) Hide subagent child sessions and add per-step teardown guards (Matt Zinkevicius)
